description.content: Return rating reviews for a resource.

query.description: Filter list output  with ratings for a knowledge collection.
Unique ID of the exchange item; if supplied, overrides the collection ID as a filter item; default is no entry.

Ratings included in requested review status; defaults to UNSPECIFIED.

 - UNSPECIFIED: Not a valid retrieval rating value.
 - PENDING: Waiting to be inspected for approval or rejection.
 - COMPLETE: Inspected and acted upon; no further action taken.
Filter list output to only include ratings made by a given user.
Rank value given by the user; valid responses are 1 (negative) and 5 (positive).
Maximum page size is 100; default is 100.
For multiple pages; must be specified in each request for two pages per sheet.
Sort order for multi page requests; valid options are rank, rank desc, create_time, create_time desc.
